description: Audited doc-debt baseline (B1 independent review finding B1-R6): the originally 84 pre-existing R-README-SECTIONS violations in the ultralytics_yolo pilot, whose README rewrite is deferred to batch B9 by the approved migration plan. Each entry pins the exact finding message, so only these exact violations are tolerated: any new violation (this sample, any other sample, or any other rule) still fails the gate, and fixing a listed violation turns its entry into an 'unused exemption' violation, forcing the baseline to shrink. B9 must delete this file and the --exemptions flag from sample-contract.yml.
